import sys

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) < 2:
            break
        p = int(parts[0])
        k = int(parts[1])
        if k == 0:
            l = p - 1
        elif k == 1:
            l = p
        else:
            t = 1
            v = k
            while True:
                v = (v * k) % p
                t += 1
                if v == 1:
                    break
            l = p // t
        ans = pow(p, l, MOD)
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
